name: Ferienwohnung Juffinger Georg
beschreibung:
Quietly nestled in the idyllic Thiersee valley, the Juffinger family welcomes guests with authentic Tyrolean warmth. The comfortably equipped apartment provides an ideal haven for families and outdoor lovers.

Nearby Lake Thiersee is perfect for swimming and boating in summer, while scenic walking routes up Mount Pendling start close by.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Juffinger Georg in Thiersee offers warm family hospitality and peaceful relaxation in Kufsteinerland.
